business_overview.revenue_model: Monthly/quarterly property management fees, value-added services, developer/government service contracts and city services fees.
business_notes: As at 31 December 2025, business covered 145 cities, 1,428 projects, GFA under management 221.2 million sq.m. and contracted GFA 334.6 million sq.m.
Credit terms: property management fees generally due when demand notes are issued; value-added and city service receivables normally due within 30 to 90 days.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow was strong, but it relied on a RMB1.105bn decrease in other operating assets while trade receivables increased RMB1.053bn and ECL charges remained high; reported profit cash conversion is therefore not treated as clean distributable cash.

gaps: Annual fact pack was newly generated from 2025 annual report; 2023 cash flow/capex detail was not stored because only stock_report_paths for 2025 are writable in this run.
Annual report does not split cash by listed parent/offshore holding company versus Mainland operating subsidiaries.
Time deposits over three months are not split into 3-12 months versus over one year.
No precise disclosure of minimum operating cash requirement; this analysis estimates it from one month of operating cash costs.
